    1. render(GraphicsContext)

Interface Renderable

All Known Implementing Classes:
Bible, Blue, Cleave, Dismantle, Infinity, Lazer, MalevolentKitchen, MaximumBlue, MaximumCleave, MaximumDismantle, MaximumOutputInfinity, MaximumRed, Red, Standard, UnlimitedHollowPurple, Weapon
public interface Renderable
Implemented by every game object that draws itself on the main game canvas.

GameCanvas calls render(GraphicsContext) on all renderable objects each frame, passing the canvas's GraphicsContext so the object can draw its sprite, shape, or text.

Rendering coordinates should be converted from world-space to screen-space using GameManager.getScreenX(double) and GameManager.getScreenY(double) before drawing.

    • render

      void render(javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext gc)
      Draws this object to the game canvas.

      Called once per frame by the game loop. Implementations must not modify game state inside this method — only issue draw calls to gc.

      Parameters:
      gc - the GraphicsContext of the game canvas
